prompt.content: What year did Peter de Maulay go on crusade and die, probably in the Holy Land?

output:
Peter de Maulay (also spelled Maulay or de Maulay) was a French knight who went on the Third Crusade (1189–1192). He died in 1191, probably in the Holy Land.
